title: The δ-claim of step 3: θ₀I₀ ≤ c₀δ⁴ + (1+(4δ⁴/ω)²)^{n/2}k₀I₀
statement: Assume (hA), the frozen statement of the accepted sibling intcpt_allard_integrality_lemma with MonotonicityFormula discharged: for all N, n ∈ ℕ and Λ ∈ ℝ with 1 ≤ n and 1 ≤ Λ there are δ̄ > 0 and c₀ ≥ 0 such that for all δ ∈ (0,δ̄] and ε ∈ (0,δ⁴], every U ⊇ B°_3(0), every n-varifold W on U with locally bounded first variation and every P ∈ G(N,n) with μ_W(B°_3(0)) ≤ Λ, ‖δW‖(B°_3(0)) < ε² and ∫⁻_{B°_3(0)×G(N,n)} t_P dW < ε²: (a) μ_W(E) ≤ c₀ε, where E is the set of y ∈ B_2(0) ∩ spt μ_W violating (1) ‖δW‖(B_ρ(y)) ≤ εμ_W(B_ρ(y)) for all ρ ∈ (0,1) or (2) ∫⁻_{B_ρ(y)×G(N,n)} t_P dW ≤ ερ^n for all ρ ∈ (0,1); (b) for every x ∈ P.plane with |x| < 1, every finite set s of points y with p_P y = x, y ∈ B_2(0) ∩ spt μ_W, (1), (2) and |y − p_P y| < ε, and every Θ : ℝ^N → [0,∞] with HasDensity n μ_W y Θ(y) and Θ(y) ≥ 1 for y ∈ s: Σ_{y∈s} Θ(y) ≤ ofReal(1+δ)·μ_W(B_1(x))/unitBallVolume n + ofReal δ; (hD), the frozen statement of the accepted sibling intcpt_integral_density_integer: every integral n-varifold V on any U ⊆ ℝ^N has, for μ_V-a.e. x, HasDensity n μ_V x k for some integer k ≥ 1; (hC), the frozen statement of the accepted sibling intcpt_canonical_tangent_representation with AllardRectifiabilityTheorem and FirstRectifiabilityTheorem discharged: every n-varifold V on any U with locally bounded first variation and Θ^n(μ_V,x) > 0 for μ_V-a.e. x admits θ : ℝ^N → ℝ with IsVarifoldOf V M_V θ, where M_V := {x ∈ spt μ_V : V has a tangent plane at x}, such that every x ∈ M_V has a tangent plane with multiplicity θ(x) and HasDensity n μ_V x (ofReal θ(x)), and every μ_V-null Z ⊆ M_V is H^n-null; (hG), the frozen statement of the accepted sibling intcpt_lipschitz_graph_fibre_bound: for all N, n, P ∈ G(N,n), L ≥ 0, closed sets Γ_i (i ∈ ℕ) with |(y−z) − p_P(y−z)| ≤ L|p_P(y−z)| for all y, z ∈ Γ_i, every H^n-null-measurable set A ⊆ ⋃_i Γ_i and every h : ℝ^N → [0,∞]: ∫⁻_A h dH^n ≤ ofReal((1+L²)^{n/2})·∫⁻_{P.plane} Σ'_{y ∈ A, p_P y = a} h(y) dH^n(a); and (TGC), the tangent-graph-cover statement: for all N, n, 0 < L ≤ 1, U ⊆ ℝ^N, every n-varifold V on U and every P ∈ G(N,n) there are closed sets Γ_i (i ∈ ℕ) with |(y−z) − p_P(y−z)| ≤ L|p_P(y−z)| for all y, z ∈ Γ_i, such that every x at which V has some tangent plane T with some multiplicity θ (HasTangentPlane V x T θ) and |p_T v − p_P v| ≤ (L/4)|v| for all v ∈ ℝ^N lies in some Γ_i. Let N, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, P ∈ G(N,n), θ₀ > 0 and W_k (k ∈ ℕ) n-varifolds on B°_5(0), each integral with locally bounded first variation, with ‖δW_k‖(B°_5(0)) → 0 and (H): ∫ f dW_k → θ₀ ∫ f dv(P) for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n), ℝ) with tsupport f ⊆ B°_5(0) × G(N,n). Then there are δ̄ > 0, c₀ ≥ 0 and I₀ > 0 such that for every δ ∈ (0, δ̄] and k₀ ∈ ℕ with (1+δ)(θ₀+δ) + δ < k₀ + 1 and 4δ⁴ ≤ ω: θ₀I₀ ≤ c₀δ⁴ + (1 + (4δ⁴/ω)²)^{n/2}·k₀·I₀, where ω := (unitBallVolume n).toReal. Notation: H^n := μHE[n]; G(N,n) := Grassmannian N n; p_S := Grassmannian.project S (orthogonal projection onto S.plane); t_P(S) := ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap(projectionLinearMap S − projectionLinearMap P)‖ (operator norm of p_S − p_P); μ_W := W.weight; ‖δW‖ := variationMeasure W; v(T) := planeVarifoldMeasure T; B_ρ(y) := closedBall y ρ, B°_ρ(y) := ball y ρ; unitBallVolume n is the extended-real volume of the open unit ball of ℝ^n; ofReal := ENNReal.ofReal.
